answer_1.quote: Our task is generally defined as follows: Given the input of objective background information I and subjective semantic constraints C, our model is to help the machine automatically grounding the inputs to the text output Y.
answer_1.outputs: text of the recipe which satisfies the user preferences with the given ingredients

answer_2.quote: In order to evaluate the effectiveness of our methods, we introduce the automatic metrics as follows: BLEU-4 is a commonly used metric to measure the quality of machine generated texts. Dis2 is the ratio of distinct bi-grams in the generated recipes, which depicts the diversity.

answer_4.quote: We ask 9 judges on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate the recipes in a Likert scale. Three native English speakers are asked to give a score on each recipe with the following descriptions
answer_4.guideline: Readability denotes whether the recipe is fluent and easy to understand. Accuracy denotes whether the given ingredients are correctly used in the recipe. Feasibility denotes whether the recipe is feasible. Creativity denotes whether the recipe is innovative. Overall denotes the overall quality of the recipe.
